## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      5 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 27 jun 2026 - 4 oct 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Бубазвон_, 30 sept 2026, 1/5: "Total freeze after app launch"
            2. _LzGer_, 28 sept 2026, 1/5: "Worked perfectly until the latest update. Now the app constantly freezes and won’t sync with the fitness band, making it basically useless. This needs to be fixed urgently — please release an update as soon as possible."
            3. _Teessiderang_, 30 ago 2026, 1/5: "This App keeps force closing on me. It is very slow to update doesn't do it in real time like Zepp does. If it doesn't improve when it comes to buying another Mi band I think I'll look for another Brand instead Update: its still lousy and at the moment can't get the App to show me anything. Its virtually useless!!! Updated 02.06.26 have tried to factory reset device, delete and reinstalled the App and it now refuses to connect and will only show the QR code. Utterly useless. Xiaomi you have lost a loyal customer Updated 29.08.26 This App will not let report to Feedback. This is the only way I can vent my frustrations. It will not sync correctly to my phone. The data on the device is completely different to the data presented on the app. How can you tell how you are progressing if the data on the phone is incorrect? Do Xiaomi even check this feedback on the App Store? I very much doubt it as they have never replied to me."
